Standard-issue '''survival packs''' were backpacks issued to both regular [[Alliance Forces]]<ref name="RASB" /> and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]<ref name="RoE" /> for field survival. The [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] contained a wide array of gear, including two weeks worth of [[Ration pack/Legends|ration packs]], three [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], two [[Flare|thermal flares]], [[di-chrome]] [[DuraShelter/Legends|shelter]], [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], six meters of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], utility [[Knife/Legends|knife]] with [[self-sharpening sheath]],<ref name="RASB" /> [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power pack]],<ref name="RoE" /> and a portable [[Power fusion generator|fusion power generator]].<ref name="RASB" />

Depending on the mission requirements, additional equipment was available for Alliance forces, including a [[Vibropick/Legends|vibropick]], [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]], [[pocket computer]], [[recording rod]], portable [[field scanner]], [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], an [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]], [[exposure suit]], and a portable [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]].
